$comment: Wall-clock, memory and size ratchets (handoff item 24, audit L9). Checked by tools/ci/timing-ratchet.mjs on the JSON the existing benches write. Separate from tools/measure/perf-ratchet.json, which holds deterministic boot COUNTS (tools/ci/perf-ratchet.mjs). A baseline moves one way: when the check prints 'lower the baseline to X', put X in this file in the same commit. A baseline of null is unset: the check prints the first measured value and passes; record it here, do not guess it.

scanColdMs.measuredBy: pnpm bench:scan --no-big: repos[0].cliColdMs.median (cli.js scan --no-cache of the pinned commit)

attachColdMs.measuredBy: pnpm bench:scan --no-big: repos[0].attachColdMs.median (app --repo spawn to /api/status attached; the cold attach the window waits for). A cached attach is not measured by any existing bench; add it to scan-bench before ratcheting it.

oneFileRescanMs.measuredBy: pnpm bench:scan --no-big: repos[0].oneFileRescanMs.median (edit one file, POST /api/scan)

idleRssKb.measuredBy: pnpm bench:scan --no-big: repos[0].settledRssKb.median (engine RSS once CPU < 2 % for 5 s after the attach scan)

windowShownMs.measuredBy: pnpm test:release report.json, row window-shown: 'window shown N ms after launch'. The 2,000 ms budget in tools/release-smoke stays as is; this is a per-class ratchet below it.

serverBytes.measuredBy: total file bytes under packages/desktop/release/*-unpacked/resources/server (--server-dir; dirSize from tools/release-smoke/lib.mjs, the same number the server-size budget reads)

installerBytes.measuredBy: size of the installer the release workflow uploads (--installer <packages/desktop/release/*.exe>)

clientColdStartMs.measuredBy: node tools/bench/client/run.mjs --runs 10 --only a,b,c, summary['coldStartMs'].median (packaged app, shopfront, throttle 1), passed as --client <json>
